title: Swim
summary:
Aqualuna at Bayside, a condo in Toronto's East Bayfront, is a made up of a pair of peaks with a valley in its middle, and at the bottom of the valley? A pool of clear blue water of course, just where you want to enjoy a swim of a warm summer day. 

Looking down on the pool between the two peaks at Aqualuna at Bayside, image by UrbanToronto Forum contributor hawc
